title: The last layout changes are inconvenient for small devices
symptom: The user reports that recent layout changes using Material Card View and Material Button take up too much space on small screens, making it hard to see the graph. They changed the margin-top from 4 dp to 1 dp to see the graph again, but the material buttons are still problematic.
cause: The layout changes introduced Material Card View and Material Button which increased margins and spacing, reducing usable space on small screens.
fix: A pull request (nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/1652) was made to change the former workaround margin, presumably reducing the margin on material buttons. The user thanked for the effort and finding solutions.
settings_changed: margin-top → 1 dp (changed by user from 4 dp to 1 dp in Material Card View)
